plugins.name: kotlin-fullstack
plugins.description: Skills for Kotlin full-stack work: a product brief for documentation and design, a backlog loop (one item, one pull request), KMP project layout, the shared wire contract, Ktor server features compiled to JVM and Kotlin/Native, a new Kotlin/Native service stood up from nothing to a deployed image, Compose Multiplatform client features, screens built from a design canvas and measured against it, testing across both, naming and abstraction conventions, releasing a library and verifying it as a consumer, and binding a C library into Kotlin/Native so that consumers link.

plugins.name: research-method
plugins.description: A study, spike or measurement campaign whose verdicts survive review: pre-registration frozen by script, pinned stand, positive controls, a measured ruler, interleaved arms, a verdict per question with every number traceable to its log.
